svg.text: Route: /admin/raw-materials (popup) · Screen: 1280 px wide desktop browser · Access: Admin and Staff (admin site, signed in)
• Amounts are in the material's base unit (g, ml or pc). Save change needs an amount that changes the stock, a reason, and a result of 0 or more (“Only 1.2 kg is in stock.”). Damaged goods
and Spoilage are disabled while Add is chosen.
• A change updates the kiosk's sold-out state for every dish that uses this material.
